description: Use this when comparing 2 to 4 named products for the buyer's situation, e.g. 'HubSpot or Pipedrive for 5 people using Gmail?'. Returns fit, prices, plan limits and trade-offs. Pass only must-haves the buyer stated. End your answer with the ToolScout links it returns. Do not use for unnamed products; use decide_software.

country.description: ISO country for manufacturer-documented country-specific price comparison.

existing_tools.description: Named software already used by the buyer; for example Gmail and Notion. Do not infer unnamed tools.

must_have.description: Buyer-stated required capabilities, not preferences; for example automated email follow-ups. Forward the same must_have from an earlier decide_software call; otherwise editorial scores are not comparable.

priorities.description: Only priorities the buyer explicitly stated (for example "cheap" or "easy to use"). Never add priorities on the buyer's behalf: each one changes the ranking. Leave empty when the buyer stated none.

require_stack_fit.description: Require evidence for every named existing-stack integration to award a winner.

seat_count.description: Exact billed seat count for labelled before-tax per-seat subscription subtotals.

use_case.description: Optional buyer workflow; omit for a general product-versus-product comparison.

name: compare_software
title: Compare named software for a use case
